tasks.name: cap_pen
tasks.instruction: Pick up the pen and the pen cap, then put the cap on the pen.

tasks.name: classify_objects
tasks.instruction: Classify the two types of objects on the table and place them into the two baskets.

tasks.name: cover_blocks
tasks.instruction: Cover the three blocks from left to right, then uncover them again in the order of red, green, and blue.

tasks.name: disassemble_LEGO
tasks.instruction: Take apart the assembled LEGO structure and place all the pieces into the bowl.

tasks.name: fill_pen_holder
tasks.instruction: Pick up the pen holder and place all the pens into it.

tasks.name: hang_mugs
tasks.instruction: Hang the mugs on the mug rack.

tasks.name: insert_charger
tasks.instruction: Insert the charger plug into the power strip, then connect the charging cable to the plug.

tasks.name: insert_tubes
tasks.instruction: Pick up the test tubes on the table and insert them into the test tube rack.

tasks.name: make_bread
tasks.instruction: Pick up the two slices of bread from the bowl and place them into the toaster, then place the two small bowls on the plate.

tasks.name: make_food
tasks.instruction: Take the cutting board out and place it on the table. Then place the steak and the knife on the cutting board, put the vegetables and shrimp into the pot, place the pot on the stove, and finally cover it with the lid.

tasks.name: pack_and_pour_fruit
tasks.instruction: Place all the fruits into the blue bowl, then pour the fruits from the blue bowl into the large white bowl.

tasks.name: pack_objects_into_backpack
tasks.instruction: Place all the objects on the table into the backpack.

tasks.name: put_objects_into_basket
tasks.instruction: Place all the objects on the table into the basket.

tasks.name: stack_and_cover_blocks
tasks.instruction: Stack the blocks on the table, then cover them with the cup.

tasks.name: stack_bowls
tasks.instruction: Stack the bowls on the table.

tasks.name: store_in_safe
tasks.instruction: Place all the objects into the safe, then close the safe.

tasks.name: sweep_blocks
tasks.instruction: Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the blocks.

prompt_template: A video recorded from a robot's point of view executing the following instruction: {task}
